design_reference_handoffs.scope: Visual analysis and implementation criteria only; no new build, deployment or QA claimed.
design_reference_handoffs.instruction: Read this brief alongside reference-two-cinematic-collections.md before the next visual change. Retain rato.'s warm editorial identity and three collection moments. Prepare a coherent static hero and product assets first, then selective video/3D; do not globally prohibit 3D based on the superseded early event. Preserve direct catalog navigation, reduced-motion and truthful conceptual labels. Reconcile the latest repository page with prior local improvements rather than replacing recent work.
